name: La Cour des Consuls Hotel & Spa Toulouse
positioning: MGallery hotel set in two 18th-century private mansions in the heart of Toulouse, the Pink City, with a spa and period decor blended with contemporary design
best_for: Travelers who want a historic base in the heart of Toulouse, close to the Garonne and Old Toulouse
Guests who want a spa stay with a hammam and steam bath in the city centre

facts.text: The historic building sits behind a neo-classical pink brick facade.
The hotel is in the heart of the Pink City, a stone's throw from the banks of the Garonne and Old Toulouse.
The hotel is part of the MGallery Hotel Collection.
The building's interiors feature marble, mouldings, parquet floors and high ceilings.
The spa is designed to resemble a bourgeois apartment in a world of white, and works with the Graine de Pastel and Gemology brands.
The fitness centre is reserved exclusively for hotel guests.
Superior Rooms with a bath have a king-size bed and a marble bathroom.
Classic rooms have a distinctly contemporary decor that contrasts with the character of the building.
Le Cénacle is a fine-dining restaurant in a centuries-old family home, which guests can pair with the cocktail bar Le 46.
Breakfast features fresh, homemade and locally sourced produce.
The Library, a meeting room with quirky decor, holds up to 45 people.

highlights.text: The hotel is housed in two 18th-century private mansions.
The spa has four treatment cabins bathed in natural light, a steam bath, a traditional hammam, a relaxation room and an herbal tea room.
Period decor and the family coat of arms sit alongside contemporary design.
Rooms overlook the hotel's two inner courtyards.

considerations.text: Classic rooms are contemporary in style rather than period, contrasting with the historic building.
WhataHotel notes the historic building may have space limitations in some rooms.
